# AcuTherapy Clinics

> Licensed acupuncture and Traditional Chinese Medicine clinics in
> Honolulu and Aiea, Hawaii. Evidence-based pain management and
> holistic care for chronic pain, sports injuries, sciatica, neck
> and back pain, auto accident injuries, and general wellness.

## Insurance Accepted
We accept a wide range of insurance plans, including:
- Workers' Compensation
- Auto accident insurance (Hawaii No-Fault / PIP)
- Veterans Community Care
- UHA (University Health Alliance)
- HMAA (Hawaii Mainland Administrators)
- Medicare Supplement plans
- AARP
- Humana

Coverage for acupuncture varies by plan. Please check with your
insurance carrier to confirm acupuncture coverage before your visit.

Insurance details: https://acutherapy.com/insurance-accepted
